story.titleZh: 阿塞拜疆大奖赛第31圈：阿尔本撞墙出赛 安全车出动
story.summaryZh: 红牛车队在X上发布阿塞拜疆大奖赛战报：第31圈（共51圈）安全车出动，阿尔本撞墙，人已离车并无大碍，威廉姆斯赛车仍卡在赛道旁，红牛车手暂列第三和第四。
story.originalTitle: LAP 31/51: SAFETY CAR 🟡 Alex finds the wall, but is out of the car and okay. The Williams is still wedged in... We're P3 and P4. #F1 || #Azerbaijan...
story.summaryEn:
LAP 31/51: SAFETY CAR 🟡
Alex finds the wall, but is out of the car and okay. 
The Williams is still wedged in... We're P3 and P4.
#F1 || #AzerbaijanGP 🇦🇿
detailZh:
第31圈（共51圈）：安全车出动🟡
阿尔本撞上护墙，但已离开赛车且安然无恙。
威廉姆斯赛车仍卡在原地……我们目前排在第三和第四。
#F1 || #阿塞拜疆大奖赛 🇦🇿
detailEn:
LAP 31/51: SAFETY CAR 🟡
Alex finds the wall, but is out of the car and okay. 
The Williams is still wedged in... We're P3 and P4.
#F1 || #AzerbaijanGP 🇦🇿
keyPointsZh: 阿尔本已安全离开赛车，没有受伤
红牛两位车手当时位居第三和第四
keyPointsEn: The race spans 51 laps and the incident happened on lap 31
Albon got out of the car safely and was uninjured
Red Bull's two drivers were running third and fourth at the time
